East Sacramento.headline: East Sacramento: A Quiet Valley Day, Then Fog
East Sacramento.text: East Sacramento stays mostly quiet Tuesday as clouds increase ahead of a weak front. Rain is favored overnight and west of the valley, while Sacramento should turn drier Wednesday afternoon. East Sacramento should see a brief wet period overnight, then a drier Thanksgiving; valley fog may linger in sheltered areas. Thanksgiving looks seasonable, though a more active Pacific pattern may return late in the weekend and continue into early next week.
